mapper.sql: FROM dbo.sdpm026 WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm027 WITH (NOLOCK) ON sdpm027.pm02701 = sdpm026.pm02601 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm002 WITH (NOLOCK) ON sdpm002.pm00200 = sdpm027.pm02703 WHERE sdpm026.pm02603 LIKE '%' + #{basId} + '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT name, basId, batchNo, storageLocation, expireDate FROM ( SELECT sdpm002.pm00202 AS name, sdpm026.pm02603 AS basId, sdpm026.pm02631 AS batchNo, sdpm027.pm02726 AS storageLocation, sdpm027.pm02725 AS expireDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY sdpm026.pm02603 ASC, sdpm026.pm02631 ASC, sdpm027.pm02725 ASC, sdpm027.pm02701 ASC ) AS rowNum
) pageRows WHERE rowNum > #{offset} AND rowNum <= #{offset} + #{pageSize} ORDER BY rowNum ASC
